newsitem.title: USA: Benton Oil pilot tests 23,482 bbl/day.
newsitem.headline: Benton Oil pilot tests 23,482 bbl/day.

text.p: Benton Oil and Gas Co said Tuesday the high volume horizontal pilot well drilled in the Tucupita Field of Venezuela's South Monagas Unit produced at a rate of 23,482 barrels of oil per day (BPD), with no water, on a 12-hour initial test.
The TEX-69 well was drilled to determine the feasibility of using high volume lifting utilizing horizontal well technology in the Tucupita Field, Benton explained.
The sustainable rate of daily oil production and water oil ratio trends from this well cannot be determined until additional testing is completed.
The well has been temporarily shut-in until additional production and transportation facilities are completed.
Benton said production from the TEX-59 will start in the next ten days upon the completion of truck loading facilities and initially will be limited to 2,500 to 3,000 barrels daily.

The Tucupita Field was discovered by Texaco Inc in 1945 and produced 67 million barrels of oil and 135 million barrels of water. It was operated by Lagoven SA since 1976 before being shut-in in 1985 due to high water production.
